entries.6e56ec7cd23c7670: Total operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 rose 8.4% year on year to ¥15,084 million, and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥382 million. entries.7d6aa33c3154b8b9: The company has adopted the management philosophy “We serve to bring richer lives and happiness to local communities through our business activities,” and its policy is to pursue business that values the individuality of each store, from the perspective of residents who share the same community as its customers. Its seven-year medium- to long-term management plan, covering the fiscal years ended February 2021 to February 2027, positions continuous improvement in average daily sales per store and franchisee profit as the most important indicators, and sets “optimization of individual stores” and “stabilization of franchisee management” as its priority strategies.
